dedupe_keys.name: glombo global materials modelling with economics informed material flow analysis and bayesian optimisation

description: Python code and data for modelling key mineral supply chains by combining material flow analysis with economic behaviour, tuned to history with Bayesian optimisation. The Zenodo record says it supports the Journal of Industrial Ecology article "Understanding key mineral supply chain dynamics using economics-informed material flow analysis and Bayesian optimization" (2024) by John Ryter, Karan Bhuwalka, Michelena O'Rourke, Luca Montanelli, David Cohen-Tanugi, Richard Roth and Elsa Olivetti. The GitHub README says case study inputs sit in an Excel workbook, a database of literature elasticities is included, the model runs from run.py with a conda environment or pip install, and the full historical tuning took several days on a 24-core PC with 64 GB of RAM. Release v0.0-alpha-0 (7 September 2023) is a downloadable ZIP of about 1.15 GB under a licence Zenodo labels other open. Coverage is global commodity markets. Caveats: the minerals covered are not listed on the pages read, runs are heavy, and the README warns of instability, advising many iterations. For simulation it projects mineral supply, demand and price responses, to test supply chain shocks for infrastructure materials such as copper. A related catalogue record is the 2020 critical mineral flows in EV battery cathode supply chains.
